BeltPouch.Name: Belt Pouch
BeltPouch.Description: A small leather pouch on the belt. Ammunition, a lighter, a few keys.

CoatPockets.Name: Coat Pockets
CoatPockets.Description: The deep pockets of an overcoat or field jacket. Room for a handgun and small things.

TacticalVest.Name: Tactical Vest
TacticalVest.Description: Load-bearing vest with magazine and utility pouches. Everything within reach.

Satchel.Name: Satchel
Satchel.Description: Shoulder bag for notebooks, a camera and the day's essentials.

DoctorsBag.Name: Doctor's Bag
DoctorsBag.Description: Hinged leather medical bag. Fits a first aid kit, instruments and a revolver.

AttacheCase.Name: Attaché Case
AttacheCase.Description: A rigid case with a foam-lined interior. Packed well, it holds a rifle and sidearms.

Backpack.Name: Backpack
Backpack.Description: Everyday canvas or nylon backpack. Takes a shotgun, but not a full-length rifle.

GunCase.Name: Gun Case
GunCase.Description: Long hard case for rifles and shotguns. Not much room for anything else.

Suitcase.Name: Suitcase
Suitcase.Description: Travel suitcase. Plenty of room, but slow to open in a hurry.

MilitaryRucksack.Name: Military Rucksack
MilitaryRucksack.Description: Framed field pack for long operations and expeditions.

DuffelBag.Name: Duffel Bag
DuffelBag.Description: Long cylindrical kit bag. Fits long guns and a lot of gear.

SteamerTrunk.Name: Steamer Trunk
SteamerTrunk.Description: Heavy travel trunk for an expedition. Not something you carry while running.
